test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 4: BULK STUDENT MANAGEMENT AND REMOVAL - Phase 2: Test Multi-Email Enrollment
test_cases.test_case_title: Multi-Email Enrollment with Valid and Invalid Data
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher is logged into the system and has navigated to a pre-existing course's 'Students' tab. The 'Add New Attenders Modal' is open, and the 'Multiple' tab is selected, displaying the 'Emails Text Area'.
test_cases.expected_result: The system should report 2 successful enrollments (student_valid_1@example.com, student_valid_2@example.com) and 2 failures (due to invalid format and already enrolled errors). The student list is updated correctly, reflecting the successfully added students.
test_cases.post_condition: The student list for the course is updated with the successfully enrolled students. The Teacher remains on the 'Students' tab of the 'Course Details Page'.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Software Engineering' course from the Course List on the Dashboard.
Click the 'Students' tab on the 'Course Details Page'.
Click the 'Add Student' button to open the 'Add new attenders' modal.
Click the 'Multiple' tab within the 'Add new attenders' modal.
Enter 'student_valid_1@example.com, student_valid_2@example.com, invalid-email, student_already_enrolled@example.com' into the 'Emails Text Area' field.
